cross_scenario_conclusion.recommended_binary_mapping: Map labels beginning flow=From-Botnet to ATTACK/BOTNET. Map explicitly Background and From-Normal/Normal-labelled traffic to BENIGN only for flow-level labels, retaining the original label provenance. Do not equate every non-Botnet label to NORMAL; labels outside these explicit sets require review.
cross_scenario_conclusion.recommended_attack_type_mapping: The exact family (Neris, RBot, Virut, DonBot, Sogou, Murlo, NSIS Agent) comes from official scenario metadata, not the Label field. A From-Botnet label can be assigned that scenario family only when used within that scenario?s own flow data.
cross_scenario_conclusion.background_treatment: Background is traffic from other network hosts, distinct from the specifically identified normal hosts. For a practical binary flow target it can be grouped as benign/background, but it is not semantically identical to From-Normal and should remain distinguishable in provenance. It must not be projected onto botnet-only PCAP packets without a reliable alignment method.
important_caveats: These are flow-label semantics only; the prior audit found several PCAP and .binetflow time ranges incompatible, so this report does not authorize packet-to-flow joins.
To-Botnet and To-Normal labels, if present, are not automatically malicious/benign merely from direction; the official note describes them as traffic sent by unknown computers.
Scenario family is metadata-backed; detailed behavior/attack subtypes are not established by the Label strings alone.
No labels are applied to any existing PCAP feature dataset.
